name: Basilica Aemilia
type: civil basilica; archaeological site; destroyed building or structure
text: The Basilica Aemilia (Italian: Basilica Emilia), or the Basilica Paulli, was a civil basilica in the Roman Forum. Lucius Aemilius Paullus initiated its construction, but the building was completed by his son, Paullus Aemilius Lepidus, in 34 BCE. Under Augustus, it was reconstructed in 22 CE and was described by Pliny as one of the most beautiful examples of Roman architecture.

depictions.name: Basilica Emilia
depictions.text: The Basilica Aemilia (Italian: Basilica Emilia) was a structure in Rome that once stood in the Forum. Its remains survive to this day.
